split_policy: No fitting. All King County 2023-2025 elections and related contests/snapshots stay in the held-out reconstruction group. Historical outcomes are public and have previously been inspected; this is computational phase separation, not blind preregistration.
pool_recipe: round(as-of maximum district registered voters * dated county turnout projection plus offset) minus as-of maximum district ballots. If <=0, withhold: reaching a projection is not official zero. This is an assumed pool of countable ballots, with no verified acceptance/category accounting.
pair_mapping: round(positive source pool * as-of named selected-pair votes / as-of county ballots). Assumes future participation like as-of participation. Generic write-ins excluded; no whole-contest legal-winner assertion.
batch_policy: Every daily tally delta remains unknown. No positive/monotone delta is automatically a new-ballot batch; latest-batch likelihood and baseline are unavailable.
scored_scenario: base; low/high sensitivity separate, not independent additional observations
weights: Equal elections, equal contests within election, equal snapshots within contest.
uncertainty: One geographic dependence cluster. Do not bootstrap fictitious independent jurisdictions or interpret the three years as geographic replication; interval unavailable.
scope: King County, County Council districts 1-9 under both archive naming conventions, City of Seattle and Seattle council districts 1-7. Candidate tallies only, exclude measure keywords, tied/unopposed as-of pairs. Scope selected from as-of archive identities before any experiment scoring, without selecting final outcomes or margins.
outcome_definition: Strict reversal of the as-of top two named candidates in the specified original certified CSV. Ties yield no strict reversal. No adjudication of write-ins, legal winner or later recounts.
availability: Max(archive report day plus one day 16:30 America/Los_Angeles, HTTP Last-Modified). A conservative publisher-metadata reconstruction, not authenticated then-captured bytes, a count-update timestamp or proof the archive was never revised.
exclusions: All 2022 inputs (late migration timestamps), reserved/final/certification-day archives, stale >48h, identical byte snapshots, unreviewed jurisdictions/rules, unopposed/tied/no-data pairs, nonpositive assumed remainder, unsupported numerical pool.
promotion_policy: No operational eligibility or calibration established. Original prospective schema-1 evaluator remains unchanged and original EA-10/EA-13 scientific criteria remain open.

pre_run_revisions.reason: Corrected archive ordering for extra hyphens and added a synthetic regression before the first real prediction or scoring run. No outcome-informed tuning.
